libraries.name: Dates & Time
libraries.tagline: Format, shift and compare dates — including working days.
libraries.description: Date arithmetic over date-fns: format for humans or for storage, add days and business days, measure the gap between two dates, and ask whether a deadline has passed. Every function takes and returns ISO-8601 text, which is what an Etyma parameter carries.
libraries.notes: Business-day functions skip weekends only. Public holidays vary by country and change every year, so they need a calendar the app supplies — see the Business Calendar library if you need them.

functions.name: Format Date
functions.description: Format an ISO date for a person, e.g. '9 Sep 2026'. Patterns are date-fns patterns: d MMM yyyy, EEEE, HH:mm.

functions.name: Add Days
functions.description: Shift an ISO date by a number of days and return ISO. Negative subtracts.

functions.name: Add Business Days
functions.description: Shift an ISO date by working days, skipping weekends. Use for 'due in 5 working days'.

functions.name: Days Between
functions.description: Whole calendar days from the first date to the second. Negative when the second is earlier.

functions.name: Business Days Between
functions.description: Working days from the first date to the second, weekends excluded. The usual measure of an SLA.

functions.name: Is Overdue
functions.description: True when the deadline is in the past. Pass the deadline and the moment to judge it against.

functions.name: Is Weekend
functions.description: True on a Saturday or Sunday. The cheap half of a working-day check.

functions.name: Age
functions.description: How long ago, in plain words: '3 days', '2 months'. For a Last updated column.

functions.name: Start Of Day
functions.description: Midnight at the start of the date, as ISO. Use as the lower bound of a whole-day range.

functions.name: End Of Month
functions.description: The last moment of the date's month, as ISO. Billing periods, reporting windows, retention cut-offs.

libraries.name: Insight
libraries.tagline: The five things every back-office screen needs on day one.
libraries.description: KPI tiles, sparklines, status pills, progress rings and empty states — built on the theme's own tokens, so they take on the colours of whatever app they are dropped into and read correctly in both light and dark.
libraries.notes: The sparkline and the ring are hand-drawn SVG because they belong inside a table cell. For a real chart with axes and a tooltip, recharts is on Etyma's allow-list — use it.

components.name: StatTile
components.description: A headline number with an optional delta that colours itself by direction. Set invertDelta for metrics where down is good.

components.name: Sparkline
components.description: A trend line the size of a word, from a comma-separated series. Green when it ends above where it started.

components.name: StatusBadge
components.description: A status pill in one of five tones: neutral, info, success, warning, danger. A closed set on purpose.

components.name: ProgressRing
components.description: A circular proportion for places a bar will not fit — a row, a card corner, beside a label.

components.name: EmptyState
components.description: What a list says when it is empty, with a way out. Accepts children for anything extra.
